scheme_name: Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Jute Mills / MSMEs Workers
other_conditions: Girl children of workers employed in Jute Mills and MSME‑JDP units producing jute products
Eligibility applies to examinations passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 (each academic year 2021‑26)
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹5,000 for secondary education and ₹10,000 for higher secondary education for eligible girl children.
documents_required: Current pay slip of the worker
